svg.text: VLA v485 — one clock tick (40 ms), three token streams, learned register windows

n_hidden 512 · c_context 384 · 7×7 grid · depth 8 · linout 3×3 · 5 DFFs, learned windows from 512 / 64 / 16 / 4 / 1 ticks · 25 Hz clock · reset per example · frozen ResNet-50 at 2 Hz + fixed log-mel at 25 Hz · 3 token streams · batch 250 · SGD 0.04 · BPTT 16 · FineWeb
the frame on screen, refreshed at 2 Hz (--vision_hz) and held until the
next refresh · one crop offset per example · text rows: image grid = 0
W1 learned, from 512 ticks = 20 s (slow: topic within an example) · 25K MAC
W2 learned, from 64 ticks = 2.6 s · 25K MAC + 25K subtract
W3 learned, from 16 ticks = 0.64 s · 25K MAC + 25K subtract
W4 learned, from 4 ticks = 0.16 s · 25K MAC + 25K subtract
W5 = 1 (plain write, no MAC) · 25K subtract · S_1..S_4: 3×25K adds
dashed: old state r (Q) into each EMA · open circle R: reset to 0 at every example start (--continuous '', --init zero) · S_k: running sum of the new values
each read through its own 512-channel block of ctx_cat
frozen: embedding / inverse embedding (pythia-31m, shared by the 3 streams), ResNet-50
channel concatenation (3 token grids + image + audio grids + 5 registers)
conv 3×3 unpadded (linear, no BN/ReLU): the 3 decoder trees 7→5→3→1
media input: video frame (2 Hz) / 16 kHz clean sound (log-mel, a new cell every tick)
EMA multiply-accumulate, rate 1/W_k (learned, from 512, 64, 16, 4 ticks; DFF_5 is a plain write)
subtractor (−) / adder (+): x minus S_k, the running sum of the slower registers
read scale 1/σ_k (running RMS; constant at inference) · RMS: per-position norm
D flip-flop, clocked once per 40 ms tick; R = synchronous reset to 0 at an example start
data / state path (labelled where it matters)
old register value r into its EMA
last 196 frames heard (1.96 s), 4 per 40 ms cell, a new cell every tick (25 Hz), row-major 7×7 · text rows: 0
inference: each stream's sample → its next input · training: its previous dataset target (no self-feedback) · after a <NUL>: no word
v485 vs v451: linout 3×3 (was 1×1), learned register windows, truncated BPTT over 16 ticks, text-only data
windows: W_k = 1 + exp(θ_k); θ trained by Adam from a forward-mode trace dr/da carried with the
registers, so the window gradient sees every past tick, not only the 16-tick BPTT block
BPTT: 16 ticks forward with the graph through the register writes, one backward, states recomputed
streams: text = THINK, voice = HEAR, image = SEE; each has its own token DFF, ctx_cat block,
decoder tree and <NUL> logit · v485 trains the text stream only (voice, image targets: <NUL>)
targets: text = the next FineWeb word; <NUL> weight 1, loss divided by word targets (--loss_norm words)
input: each stream reads its previous target (none after <NUL>) — never its own sample
hearing: log-mel of 16 kHz sound, 64 mels of 25 ms frames every 10 ms, fixed μ/σ; grid = last 1.96 s,
4 frames per cell (a shift register in hardware) · picture: ResNet-50 grid refreshed at 2 Hz
lineage: v451 (FineWeb + FineVideo) → v455 text-only → v472 (9.73M steps) → BPTT 16, lr 0.04 →
v480 windows 256/64/16/4/1 → v482 linout 3×3 (centre-tap, same function) → v485 learned windows
registers reset at every example start · rows: FineWeb sample-10BT, 14 shards (eval: hash hold-out)
batch 250 · SGD, lr 0.04 → 4e-4 (cosine restart, 20K steps), no clipping · Adam 3e-4 on θ
~17.5 steps/s on an RTX 4090 · 14.1 GiB peak at BPTT 16
Per tick: ≈856M conv MAC (520M ContextCNN, 106M ctx_cat, 87M linout, 3 × 35M decoders, 3 × 13M lmhead)
+ 4.1G MAC frozen ResNet-50 per 2 Hz picture refresh · log-mel: 4 FFTs + 66K mel MAC per tick
+ 100K EMA MAC + 100K subtracts + 75K adds; state 5 × 512 × 7 × 7 = 125K values
